definition.simple: Valuing an open futures position at each day's settlement price, and moving that day's gain or loss into or out of the account.
definition.balanced: Gains and losses are settled in cash every day, not only when you close. A run of losing days can bring a [[margin-call]] even if you planned to hold longer.

example: Fictional: 1 contract at 10 USD per point. Today's settlement is 15 points lower than yesterday's, so 150 USD leaves the account today.
